implementation.root_cause: The native channel has one shared display-change subscription. Every Session unregisters its own Dart listener then issues false when disposed; forwarding that false unchanged disables notifications for remaining live Sessions.
implementation.owner_fact: The existing idempotent listener collection. No counter, cached native state, or asynchronous transition queue is introduced.
implementation.public_future_contract: Future<void> is preserved using MethodChannel.invokeMethod<void>. A failed call still completes with its native error; subsequent calls freshly derive the current owner state.

A scripted PlatformException before assignment models an unsuccessful native call. The actual production inbound handler is exercised using TestDefaultBinaryMessenger.handlePlatformMessage.

cases.name: disposing one Session preserves the surviving capability refresh
cases.proof: Create actual Sessions A and B; dispose A and assert native remains enabled; deliver actual native method event; B provider re-queries once and publishes HdrCapabilityChangedEvent while A provider stays at zero; repeated A dispose adds no native call; B final dispose disables.
cases.baseline_red_predicate_not_executed: A.dispose forwards false while B lives; the direct projected-value assertion fails before waiting for a missing event.

cases.name: listener registration and repeated enables do not count extra owners
cases.proof: Duplicate registration of one callback plus repeated true calls does not add ownership count. One unregister removes that callback, second returns false; the actual remaining Session keeps false projected to true; its final dispose turns the switch off.
cases.baseline_red_predicate_not_executed: Explicit false after manual callback removal wrongly disables the surviving actual Session.

cases.name: a late disable cannot unsubscribe a replacement Session
cases.proof: Dispose one real Session then create a replacement. Release a deferred old false call after replacement registration; it must project to true, with no stale owner count.
cases.baseline_red_predicate_not_executed: Late false is forwarded unchanged and disables the replacement.

cases.name: a delayed native acknowledgement does not retain a disposed owner
cases.proof: Hold the first Session enable acknowledgement after native registration, create B and dispose A before releasing the old reply. B keeps the switch enabled, and final B dispose disables even after the old reply completes.
cases.baseline_red_predicate_not_executed: A.dispose forwards false despite B ownership; no artificial delayed native operation is modeled.

cases.name: native failures preserve current ownership and permit a retry
cases.proof: A failed explicit setter retains listener ownership; retry computes true while a Session lives. Failure of the last real Session dispose leaves native enabled but no Dart owner. Another explicit failed false propagates PlatformException; a fresh false retry succeeds and closes native.
cases.baseline_red_predicate_not_executed: The successful retry of false while the Session still lives wrongly switches native off.

tests.determinism: Stream observations subscribe before operations; Completers provide explicit ordering; no sleeps, randomization, test retries, or extended timeouts. Teardown releases held replies, disposes actual Sessions and unregisters owned manual callbacks.
